import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import struct
import subprocess
import tomllib

root=Path.cwd(); docs=root/'docs/work_orders'
tool=json.loads((docs/'PHASE0_TOOLCHAIN.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
vectors=json.loads((docs/'PHASE0_REFERENCE_VECTORS.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
def encode(value):return json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')).encode('utf-8')
def frame(tokens):
    result=bytearray()
    for text in tokens:
        data=text.encode('utf-8');result.extend(struct.pack('!I',len(data)));result.extend(data)
    return bytes(result)
def digest(tag,value):return hashlib.sha256(frame([tag,encode(value).decode('utf-8')])).hexdigest()
def corehash(doc):
    tree={**doc,'components':[{'schema':c['schema'],'entity_id':c['entity_id'],'hash':digest('component/v1',c)} for c in doc['components']]}
    return digest('core-root/v1',tree)
for v in vectors['pack_vectors']:
    assert frame(v['tokens']).hex()==v['hex']
    assert hashlib.sha256(frame(v['tokens'])).hexdigest()==v['sha256']
assert vectors['pack_vectors'][1]['hex']!=vectors['pack_vectors'][2]['hex']
for d in vectors['documents']:
    assert encode(d['document']).decode()==d['utf8']
    assert encode(d['document']).hex()==d['utf8_hex']
    assert digest(d['tag'],d['document'])==d['sha256']
fixture=vectors['golden_fixture']; header=fixture['trace']['header']; previous=fixture['initial_core']
assert corehash(previous)==header['initial_core_hash']
assert digest('protocol/v1',fixture['initial_protocol'])==header['initial_protocol_hash']
for index,step in enumerate(fixture['trace']['steps']):
    w=step['witness'];c=w['core'];p=w['protocol'];facts=w['facts'];diff=w['diff']
    assert corehash(c)==step['core_hash']
    assert digest('protocol/v1',p)==step['protocol_hash']
    assert digest('turn-facts/v1',facts)==step['facts_hash']
    assert digest('turn-diff/v1',diff)==step['diff_hash']
    if index<3:
        values={v['schema']['kind']:v['fields'] for v in c['components']}
        assert values['skeleton.position']['x']==[1,0,0][index]
        assert values['skeleton.counter']['visits']==index+1==c['tick']==p['revision']
        receipt=step['outcome']['receipt'];assert receipt['core_hash']==step['core_hash']
        event=facts[0];h=event['header']
        expected='e1-'+hashlib.sha256(frame(['event-id/v1',c['world_id'],str(c['tick']),'RESOLVE','0','skeleton.stepper','0'])).hexdigest()
        assert h['event_id']==expected and len(facts)==1 and h['producer_rank']==0
        if index==2:assert len(diff['changes'])==1 and event['payload']=={'from_x':0,'to_x':0}
        assert step['facts_hash']!=digest('turn-facts/v1',[])
    else:
        assert c==previous and facts==[] and diff is None
        if index==3:assert step['outcome']['receipt']==fixture['trace']['steps'][0]['outcome']['receipt']
        if index==4:assert step['outcome']['failure']['code']=='STALE_REVISION' and step['outcome']['current_revision']==3
    previous=c
for v in vectors['rng_vectors']:
    key=bytes.fromhex(v['key_sha256']);a=v['address'];width=v['high_exclusive']-v['low'];limit=2**64-(2**64%width)
    framed=frame(['rng-key/v1',header['world_seed_hex'],header['world_id'],str(a['logical_tick']),a['phase'],str(a['wave']),a['engine_id'],a['entity_id'],a['purpose'],a['causal_key']])
    assert framed.hex()==v['pack_hex'] and hashlib.sha256(framed).digest()==key
    drawn=[]
    for attempt in v['attempts']:
        u=struct.unpack('!Q',hashlib.sha256(key+struct.pack('!Q',attempt['counter'])).digest()[:8])[0]
        assert u==attempt['u'] and (u<limit)==attempt['accepted']
        if u<limit:drawn.append(v['low']+u%width)
    assert drawn==v['draws'] and len(v['attempts'])==v['consumed_counters']
assert any(not a['accepted'] for a in vectors['rng_vectors'][-1]['attempts'])
negative=vectors['negative_vectors'];bad=negative['self_consistent_wrong_step1_fixture']['trace']['steps'][0];w=bad['witness']
assert corehash(w['core'])==bad['core_hash']==bad['outcome']['receipt']['core_hash']==w['protocol']['receipts'][0]['receipt']['core_hash']==w['diff']['receipt']['core_hash']
assert digest('protocol/v1',w['protocol'])==bad['protocol_hash'] and digest('turn-facts/v1',w['facts'])==bad['facts_hash'] and digest('turn-diff/v1',w['diff'])==bad['diff_hash']
assert w['core']['components'][1]['fields']['x']==negative['expected_leaf']==2 and fixture['trace']['steps'][0]['witness']['core']['components'][1]['fields']['x']==negative['actual_leaf']==1
assert negative['expected_first_core_path']=='$core.components[1].fields.x'
for p in tool['packages']:
    assert len(p['sha256'])==64 and '.whl' in p['wheel_url']
    assert 'win_' in p['wheel_url'] or 'none-any' in p['wheel_url']
    assert p['license'] or p['license_classifiers']
assert len(tool['packages'])==13 and all(c['exit']==c['expected_exit'] for c in tool['commands'])
assert all(v for k,v in tool['checks'].items())
md_files=list(root.glob('*.md'))+list((root/'architecture').glob('*.md'))+list((root/'docs').rglob('*.md'))
broken=[];fences=0
for path in md_files:
    text=path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert not any(line.rstrip()!=line for line in text.splitlines()),path
    assert len(re.findall(r'^```',text,re.M))%2==0,path
    for snippet in re.findall(r'(?ms)^```python\r?\n(.*?)^```',text):ast.parse(snippet);fences+=1
    cleaned=re.sub(r'(?ms)^```.*?^```','',text)
    cleaned=re.sub(r'`[^`\n]*`','',cleaned)
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',cleaned):
        target=target.strip('<>').split('#')[0]
        if not target or '://' in target or target.startswith('C:'):continue
        if not (path.parent/target).exists():broken.append((str(path),target))
assert not broken,broken
config=re.search(r'(?ms)^```toml\n(.*?)^```',(docs/'RS-PREFLIGHT-001_COMPATIBILITY.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')).group(1)
tomllib.loads(config)
assert hashlib.sha256(config.encode()).hexdigest()==tool['config_sha256']
for name in ['src','tests']:
    assert sorted(str(p.relative_to(root)) for p in (root/name).rglob('*') if p.is_file())==[name+'\\.gitkeep']
assert not (root/'pyproject.toml').exists() and not (root/'requirements-dev.lock').exists()
review=(root/'architecture/ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
protected=['docs/ASTRA_ENGINE_ARCHITECTURE_PROMPT_v2.6_AI_PRODUCED_RPG_EN.md','docs/MASTER_GAME_ARCHITECTURE.md','docs/prompts/SOL_CODING_WORK_ORDER.md','docs/reference/AGENTS_v1.md','docs/reference/QUILLTALE_CONTENT_CANDIDATES.json','architecture/BLOCK_01.md','architecture/BLOCK_07.md','architecture/BLOCK_08.md','architecture/V1_REUSE_INVENTORY.md','docs/work_orders/RS-ARCH-003_ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW.md']
for path in protected:
    match=re.search(r'^\| '+re.escape(path)+r' \| ([a-f0-9]{64}) \|$',review,re.M)
    assert match and hashlib.sha256((root/path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==match.group(1),path
order=(docs/'PHASE0_WORK_ORDERS.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
for task in ['RS-P0-002','RS-P0-004','RS-P0-001','RS-P0-003']:assert len(re.findall(r'^## '+task,order,re.M))==1
assert 'orchestration never imports app' in (docs/'PHASE0_CONTRACTS.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8').lower()
result={'exit':0,'checks':{'document_links_fences_whitespace':True,'python_interface_fences':fences,'selected_13_package_closure':True,'independent_pack_json_root_protocol_facts_diff_rng_vectors':True,'golden_steps':len(fixture['trace']['steps']),'production_absent':True,'protected_input_hashes_preserved':len(protected),'four_exact_phase0_orders':True,'config_matches_executed_probe':True},'source':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')}
tool['document_verification']=result
tool['final_input_sha256']={str(p.relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/'):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [docs/'PHASE0_CONTRACTS.md',docs/'PHASE0_WORK_ORDERS.md',docs/'PHASE0_REFERENCE_VECTORS.json',docs/'RS-PREFLIGHT-001_COMPATIBILITY.md',root/'BACKLOG.md',root/'SESSION_HANDOFF.md',root/'architecture/BLOCK_09.md']}
r=subprocess.run(['git','-c','safe.directory=C:/Reverie Saga','rev-parse','HEAD'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True);tool['head']=r.stdout.strip()
tool['dirty_inventory']=subprocess.run(['git','-c','safe.directory=C:/Reverie Saga','status','--short'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.splitlines()
(docs/'PHASE0_TOOLCHAIN.json').write_text(json.dumps(tool,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(result['checks']))
